calibration: conformal PID with nested selection, then Platt out of fold (pressure.RECALIBRATION), as published_v1, in each of the inputs combined
inputs_note: the equal-weight average of the calibrated probabilities of published_v1 and of its direct-pairs twin (the same classifier fitted with training_pairs="direct", the same conformal PID with nested selection and Platt out of fold), at each threshold. At h = 1 only: the variants are h = 1 objects, so at h = 2 to 5 the probability is published_v1's exactly. Declared in the amendment of metadata/turning_point_variant.json, before any pressure score
